captions: Sandberg Graduation Show
To announce the Sandberg Graduation Show, we designed a crumble Map and
Poster. Capable of resisting rain it was meant to be carried around during the
Graduation show between the 13 Spots all over Amsterdam, where the graduation
show was taking place.
On the backside was a poster, highlighting all the show titles of the different
venues.
